input.overview: Choose a song before the plunge, knock down a note target, and shoot the song scoop to start it. Use the inlanes to set up instruments, outfits, and TOUR progress.
input.simpleOverview: Choose a song, knock down at least one note target, and shoot the song scoop. Watch the inlanes: right then left orbit collects an instrument; left then right orbit collects an outfit.
input.summary: Choose a song, knock down a note target, and shoot the song scoop to start it. Right inlane then left orbit collects an instrument; left inlane then right orbit collects an outfit. Spell TOUR at the inlanes, then shoot the hotel target to start a Tour task.

quickInfo.name: Song mode
quickInfo.summary: Choose a song before the plunge, knock down at least one note target, then shoot the song scoop.

quickInfo.name: Instrument and outfit
quickInfo.summary: Right inlane then left orbit collects an instrument; left inlane then right orbit collects an outfit.

quickInfo.name: Band-member challenge
quickInfo.summary: Complete the blue band-member shots, then collect the challenge at the left-ramp magnet.

quickInfo.name: Tour task
quickInfo.summary: Spell TOUR through the inlanes, then shoot the hotel target to start the task.

steps.text: Choose a song before the first plunge. At the start of a later ball, change the selection if a different song is better for your progress.
Knock down at least one note target to light the song scoop, then shoot the scoop to start the selected song.
For an instrument, roll through the right inlane and then shoot the left orbit. For an outfit, roll through the left inlane and then shoot the right orbit.
Complete the blue shots for all four band members, then shoot the left ramp to the magnet to start their challenge.
Spell TOUR through the inlanes, then shoot the hotel target to start a Tour task. Complete the shown task and return to the hotel target to finish it.

playfieldReferences.label: Note drop targets
playfieldReferences.description: The drop targets used to light the selected song at the scoop.

playfieldReferences.label: Song scoop
playfieldReferences.description: The scoop that starts the selected song after note progress.

playfieldReferences.label: Hotel target
playfieldReferences.description: The target used to start and finish Tour tasks after TOUR is spelled.

playfieldReferences.context: Shoot the left ramp to the magnet to start their challenge.
playfieldReferences.label: Challenge magnet
playfieldReferences.description: The magnet at the left ramp used to begin qualified band-member challenges.
